description: This PHP class defines a validation rule for string length within a form or data validation framework. It checks whether a string's length falls within specified minimum and maximum bounds, with options for inclusive or exclusive boundaries, and supports multibyte string encoding.

classes.name: StrLength
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks whether a string's length falls within specified minimum and maximum limits, supporting inclusive/exclusive bounds and encoding options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the minimum, maximum length, encoding, and inclusivity options, with validation for logical bounds.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the input string's length satisfies the configured bounds.

methods.name: validateMin
methods.description: Checks if the string length meets the minimum length constraint, considering inclusivity.

methods.name: validateMax
methods.description: Checks if the string length respects the maximum length constraint, considering inclusivity.
